hooks.command: input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'git switch -c '*'git commit'*|*'git checkout -b '*'git commit'*) exit 0 ;; *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = main ] && { echo "Refusing to commit on main. Branch first: git switch -c <type>/<short-description>, then commit and open a PR. See .claude/rules/git-conventions.md" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
